steps.what: Record information on clients, vendors, and travel packages.
Maintain the record only after checking client and vendor information.
Keep the accepted client, vendor, and package record.

tasks.design: Information the company has already been given on clients, vendors, and travel packages is recorded in {CRM}. The travel agent checks it and maintains the record. A row with no id is not recorded. The draft does not invent a client. Only the accepted version is kept.
tasks.previous_blocker: Client and vendor details were retyped from mail into a second list.
tasks.enabler_now: Fields already given can be recorded. The agent still checks them before they are the record.
tasks.still_hard: A name that does not match the booking, or a package that has changed, is the agent's catch.
tasks.human_edge: The agent maintains the record. A filled field is not yet the current version.
tasks.altitude: The current record is the version the agent checked. Empty or unmatched fields are not stored as fact.

reach.task: Keep the client file that was checked.
reach.learn: A draft row is not the record.

evidence.claim: Client, vendor, and package fields the company has already been given can be recorded. They should not be invented.
The record holds contact details the booking needs. It is not a wider profile of the customer.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A travel agent in a mid-size European company. A tariff line is not a trip, and a draft is not a booking.
Fields: A client id, a vendor id, or a package id is required. A blank name is not stored. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the travel agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The draft copies fields already given. It does not complete a missing address.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the travel agent.
unknowns: Whether vendors are stored on the same record as clients.
research_questions: Which client details are still only in mail and not on the record?

already_counted.description: Checking and maintaining the client and vendor information stay with the agent.

incremental.description: Check the draft names the client and the package of this booking.

approvals.approved_version: record version and the client ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes details arrive with no id, so the agent types the record by hand. High assumes given fields record cleanly and the agent only checks them. A blank name is not stored.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare the reservation from the itinerary the agent already accepted.
Book by telephone, or accept the reservation made using the computer.
Send the accepted transportation and hotel reservations.

tasks.design: A reservation is prepared in {CRM} from the itinerary the agent has already accepted. The travel agent books by telephone where there is no link, or accepts the computer reservation. {PARTNER_PORTAL} sends only that accepted transportation or hotel reservation. A draft with no itinerary id is not prepared. Nothing is booked before acceptance.
tasks.previous_blocker: The agent retyped the itinerary into the carrier screen, and a telephone booking lived only on a pad.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted itinerary can prepare the reservation. The agent still accepts it before it is sent.
tasks.still_hard: A hotel that is not on the link, and any change the customer makes on the phone, is the agent's booking.
tasks.human_edge: The agent accepts the reservation or books it by telephone. A prepared draft is not a booking.
tasks.altitude: A carrier or a hotel receives a reservation only after the agent accepts that version.

reach.task: Confirm an offer before it goes to the other side.
reach.learn: A draft reservation is not the booking.

evidence.claim: A reservation can be prepared from an itinerary the agent has already accepted. It is not booked until the agent accepts it.
Sending a reservation to a carrier or a hotel is an external act. It waits for the agent's acceptance.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A travel agent in a mid-size European company. A tariff line is not a trip, and a draft is not a booking.
Fields: An itinerary id is required. With no id, the agent books by telephone as today. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the travel agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The prepared reservation copies the accepted itinerary. It does not add a hotel or a fare.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the travel agent.
unknowns: Which hotels can be booked on a link and which still need a telephone call.
research_questions: Which reservations are still held only as a telephone note?

already_counted.description: Telephone booking and acceptance of the computer reservation stay with the agent.

incremental.description: Check the draft reservation matches the itinerary the customer chose.

approvals.approved_version: reservation version and the itinerary id it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes there is no itinerary id or no carrier link, so the agent books by telephone. High assumes the draft is prepared and the agent only accepts it. Nothing is sent before acceptance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find the confirmed travel reservation on the computer link to the carrier.
Check the ticket against the confirmed reservation.
Print or request transportation carrier tickets using the printer system.

tasks.design: The confirmed travel reservation is found on the computer link to the carrier in {PARTNER_PORTAL}. The travel agent checks the ticket against that reservation. The printer system prints or requests the transportation carrier tickets only for the version the agent accepted. A reservation that is not confirmed is not printed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tickets were requested from a reservation the agent hoped had been confirmed.
tasks.enabler_now: A confirmed reservation can be found. The ticket is printed only after the agent checks it.
tasks.still_hard: A name or a date that does not match the reservation is the agent's catch before a ticket exists.
tasks.human_edge: The agent accepts the ticket. A link to the carrier does not issue it.
tasks.altitude: A ticket is printed or requested only for a reservation the agent has checked.

reach.task: Issue a document only after the record matches.
reach.learn: A carrier link is not the ticket.

evidence.claim: A confirmed reservation can be found on the carrier link. Finding it does not print a ticket.
A ticket that does not match the confirmed reservation should not be requested.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A travel agent in a mid-size European company. A tariff line is not a trip, and a draft is not a booking.
Fields: A reservation id with a confirmed status is required. Anything else is not printed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the travel agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The ticket copies the confirmed reservation. It does not change a name or a date.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the travel agent.
unknowns: Whether tickets are printed in the shop or only requested from the carrier.
research_questions: Which ticket requests are still made before the reservation shows as confirmed?

already_counted.description: Checking the ticket against the reservation stays with the agent.

incremental.description: Check the passenger name and the date match the confirmed reservation.

approvals.approved_version: ticket version and the reservation id it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes the reservation is not confirmed on the link, so the agent requests the ticket by hand. High assumes the confirmed reservation is found and the agent only checks it. Nothing prints before that check.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find brochures and publications containing travel information for that destination.
Keep foreign country regulations to the publication page that states them.

loop.purpose: Bind each answer sentence to a brochure page id.
loop.output: The sentence with a page id, or a gap.
loop.check: The page id is in a brochure the company holds, and the sentence is on that page.
loop.stop: Stop when a sentence has no page id or states a rule the page does not.
loop.why_not_simpler: A general travel note cannot tell which sentence is not in the brochure the company holds.

steps.what: Provide the customer with those brochures, including local customs and points of interest.
Give the customer the accepted answer from the publication.

tasks.design: Brochures and publications containing travel information are found in {DOCS}. An answer is drafted only where each sentence cites a page, including foreign country regulations, local customs, and points of interest. The travel agent provides the customer with the brochures and accepts or corrects the answer. {EMAIL} gives only the accepted answer. A sentence the brochure does not hold is not drafted.
tasks.previous_blocker: The agent remembered local facts, and a regulation changed without the brochure being checked.
tasks.enabler_now: A publication the company holds can be found, and a sentence with no page id can be stopped.
tasks.still_hard: A question the brochure does not answer is the agent's, said in the room, not in the draft.
tasks.human_edge: The agent provides the brochure and decides what to say beyond it. The draft cannot leave the page.
tasks.altitude: The customer receives a brochure answer only after the agent accepts it, and every sentence cites a page the company holds.

reach.task: Explain from the document, and say when it does not cover the question.
reach.learn: A page citation is the limit of the draft.

evidence.claim: An answer can be limited to a page in a brochure the company holds. It should not add a custom or a regulation the page does not state.

A chat or a written answer that informs the customer has to say when it was drafted by a system, unless the agent has reviewed it. EU AI Act article 50 is that disclosure duty. The agent reviews this answer before it is given.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A travel agent in a mid-size European company. A tariff line is not a trip, and a draft is not a booking.
Fields: A brochure id and a page id are required on every drafted sentence. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the travel agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The draft copies the page. It does not advise on a question the publication does not answer.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the travel agent.
Where the answer is given as a system draft the customer sees, it says a person reviewed it.
unknowns: Whether the customer takes a paper brochure or also wants the answer in writing.
research_questions: Which questions are asked that no current brochure answers?

already_counted.description: Providing the brochures and accepting the answer stay with the agent.

incremental.description: Read the cited sentences against the brochure before the customer receives them.

approvals.approved_version: answer version and the brochure page ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low assumes the destination has no brochure id, so the agent provides publications by hand and no answer is drafted. High assumes each sentence cites a page and the agent accepts it. Uncited advice is not sent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The travel agent still checks a client record, still accepts a reservation before it is sent, and still hands the brochure. A ticket is printed only for a reservation the agent has confirmed. An answer that leaves the brochure is not given.
reach: Real estate sales agents keep a client record they have checked, and this job learns a travel record is kept the same way.
Insurance sales agents hand a document they can stand behind, and this job learns a brochure answer cites the page.
skills_to_grow: Accept a reservation before it goes to a carrier or a hotel.
Print a ticket only for a reservation that is already confirmed.
Stop an answer that is not in the brochure the company holds.
role.ambitious_version: A reservation leaves the company only as the version the agent accepted, and a customer who asks a question the brochure does not answer hears it from the agent.
